character: Steepside lives on its tea terraces: its Pokemon are Grass and Bug types that pick, water, dry, sew and sweeten, a tea-ghost or two in the cups, and garden life that has moved into the town as if it were one more terrace (a hive with a queen, tumbleweeds against a fence, a row of Exeggcute on a wall). Leaf, flower and orchard species only.
authored_by: town author A, 2026-10-05, by hand; positions measured from derived/towns/tea_town_plan.json, tea_town_placement.json, derived/plaza_centres/tea_town.json and tools/ground.py (rounded) through tools/ambient.py's Site; y in a situation is the standing y (ground + 1). No worker stands on the square

workers.interact: The Oddish is picking the top leaves off the terrace edge and dropping them in a basket bigger than it is.
The Combee carries honeycomb from the terrace hives to the tea house kitchen. Two of its three faces watch where it is going.
The Steenee picks along the terrace edge, kicking each full basket back to the path without looking.
The Bellsprout waters the new tea seedlings one mouthful at a time, bending all the way down to each.
The tea house's Polteageist pours for the garden tables out of itself. The tea is excellent. Nobody asks.
The Sewaddle is sewing the pickers' leaf aprons behind the house, chewing each leaf soft before it stitches it.
The Leavanny carries the morning's leaf down to the drying racks, wrapped in a leaf of its own so none of it bruises.
The Shroomish tends the compost heap, which is where it would choose to be anyway.
The Sunflora turns the drying trays to follow the sun, turning itself with them.
The Bounsweet sits on the sweet-maker's back step sweetening a tray of candied fruit just by sitting near it.
The Cherrim sweeps the fallen petals off the terrace road, opening up in the sun between strokes.

pets.why: the picker's Budew sits by her basket, the only bud on the terraces she will not pick
and a Skiploom that drifts after her on a breeze
the counter keeper's Cottonee sits on the counter and is used to dust it
the tea seller's Petilil waits beside the tins; its leaves are said to be good for a cold
and a Chikorita that follows him, sniffing the samples

placed.why: a Volbeat on a ridge of the lower lane, waiting for dusk to signal across the terraces (2026-10-06)
an Illumise in a window two houses away from the Volbeat, which is the point of it (2026-10-06)
a Hoppip on the ridge, holding on against the wind
a Sunkern in the gutter, as if it had seeded there
a Gossifleur in the window box, mistaken for the flowers in it
a Seedot on the step, which the household swept off twice before it complained
a Nuzleaf on the step whistling on its leaf
a Spinda on the step, swaying, which is as still as a Spinda gets
a Fomantis on the wall top with its leaves to the sun
a Comfey in the window, hanging its flower garland on the latch
a Cutiefly on the ridge, reading the gardens' auras

situations.title: Tea for eight
situations.story: Eight teacups sit in a row on the tea house's back step. Six of them are Sinistea, and the owner has stopped trying to tell which before she pours.
situations.why: behind the tea house (east of its anchor, short of the terraces); the two flower pots are the two real cups

situations.title: The queen holds court
situations.story: A Vespiquen has taken the garden behind the drying racks for her own and two Combee wait on her, while the household eats its lunch indoors.
situations.why: the open garden east of the terrace road houses, between the seedling bed and the racks

situations.title: Blown in
situations.story: Three Bramblin rolled down from the upper terraces in the night and fetched up against a garden fence, where they are waiting for a wind going the other way.
situations.why: open garden ground east of the terrace road, below the terraces

situations.title: There were five yesterday
situations.story: A row of Exeggcute basks along the lake lane by the last house. The picker who passes them every morning swears the number changes.
situations.why: beside the lake lane, west of tea_house_01

situations.title: The smokehouse's second brew
situations.story: The smokehouse chimney has started smelling of green tea. A Poltchageist has moved into the chimney pot and steeps itself in the smoke, and the butcher's hams have never tasted better.
situations.why: on the cobblestone-wall chimney pot of tea_house_04 (butcher_shop_1), the column's top block at y120 read from the template as placed, so the feet are y121; something in a chimney, and a tea ghost in the tea town

situations.title: Asleep in the leaf bins
situations.story: The pickers tip the morning's leaves into the bins behind the end house. A Slowpoke climbed in on Tuesday and has slept in the leaves ever since; the pickers say it improves the flavour.
situations.why: the open ground east of tea_house_09 (small_house_2, back wall x2612), feet y115 from the plan; Slowpoke is one of rules.sleeps_by_day's day sleepers, so it may be posed asleep

situations.title: Ripe by Sunday
situations.story: Three Cherubi have sat in the herb patch behind the corner house for so long that the gardener has started waiting for them to ripen. She says Sunday.
situations.why: the back (west) of tea_house_07 (medium_house_2, which faces east and keeps its own little wheat plot), feet y116 from the plan
